findings.summary: The new archival-token exception is too narrow in the wrong direction: it checks player zone lists, stack object ids and combat, but not trigger_queue, pending/resolving references, stack targets, effects/shields, activation_uses or revealed. An archived token claimed by a departed owner can therefore still be a live phantom trigger/target/visibility reference and is accepted by validate().
findings.repro: A review probe loads the repaired evidence/issue17/slice12-review-demo-save.json, then pushes TriggerRef { source: ObjectId(541) (the archived Goblin Token), card: GoblinToken, controller: 0, ability: 0, seq: 0 } into game.trigger_queue and calls validate(); it prints 'VALIDATED archived token in trigger_queue'. The same probe with the id inserted in game.revealed also validates (archived token in revealed).
findings.expected: Reject the archived token whenever any live structure references it: trigger_queue, pending/resolving, stack items/targets, effects/shields, activation_uses, revealed, combat and all player zones. Keep ordinary BF->GY token cessation unchanged. Add strict negative regressions for these references.
findings.smallest_discriminator: cargo run --manifest-path evidence/issue17/slice12-review-probe/Cargo.toml -> VALIDATED archived token in trigger_queue; expected REJECTED.
